company.description: NRTC Group is an importer and exporter of fresh fruits and vegetables. The Middle East Department is the first and oldest department in NRTC. They import more than 400 tonnes of fresh fruits and vegetables daily, from Lebanon, Turkey, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Morocco, and Jordan. The products are transported by land and sea to the Dubai Central Market.
